defects.description: activation_at alone could not prove that an order was derived from a different finalized source bar. The frozen D01 rule therefore was not enforceable at the execution boundary.
defects.resolution: Added canonical ExecutionSourceLineageV2 binding source bar, action, order, and exact ledger activation; missing, late, conflicting, or same-source lineage now fails closed.

observations.description: A timestamp equal to bar.open_time is not sufficient. Equality is eligible only when canonical lineage proves a distinct finalized source bar was available by that open and matches the action, order, and ledger activation.
Adverse rounding uses ROUND_CEILING for BUY and ROUND_FLOOR for SELL. Verified with fractional tick slippage (0.5 ticks = 0.125).
Stop-limit orders are explicitly excluded from fill candidates on the trigger bar (condition: order_type == STOP_LIMIT and trigger == True). This enforces trigger/fill separation.
Bar budget is floored to quantity_step: floor(volume * max_participation_rate, quantity_step). This ensures integer-lot allocation.
Fill candidates are sorted by (int(priority), activation_at, submitted_at, order_id). This is the frozen deterministic priority order. Combined fills never exceed remaining_budget.
